title: A card on your peg
summary: It's your birthday and nobody has said, except the kit man, who has everyone's birthday in a diary. A season on, it's his, and the diary page is empty.

ends.title: His too
ends.text: He had everyone's birthday in his diary. Now somebody has his.

ends.title: Nobody knew
ends.text: He had your birthday in his diary. His own went by with nobody saying a word.

beats.title: A card on your peg

event.title: A card on your peg
event.speaker: kitman
setup: There's an envelope on your peg with your name on it in capitals. Inside is a card with a cake on it. It's your birthday, and nobody else has said a word.

say: {kitman.short} doesn't look up from the towels. "Don't make a thing of it. I've got everyone's in my diary. What are you doing tonight?"

replies.label: "How have you even got my birthday?"

say: "You wrote it on a form the day you signed. I copied it in. I've got the cleaners' and all, and the chairman's dog."

pint.text: He has one half of bitter and tells you about every kit man who came before him. You're home by nine and it's the best birthday you've had in a while.

thanks.text: He nods and goes back to the towels. The card stays on your peg until March.

lie.text: "Good." Nobody takes you anywhere. You eat a pizza on the sofa and look at the card with the cake on it.

beats.hint: The kit man has left you something

beats.title: His diary

event.title: His diary
event.speaker: kitman
setup: A season on. {kitman.short}'s diary is open on the boot room table. Every day has a name in it except today, and the staff list on the wall says today is his birthday.
{if arc.path=='pint'}You still owe him a half.{/if}

choices.label: Get the lads to sign a card.

outcomes.text: Nineteen names and a drawing of him the young lads won't explain. He puts it in the diary, on today's page, and doesn't say anything about it until Friday.

choices.label: Write it in his diary for him.

outcomes.text: You write HAPPY BIRTHDAY on today's page in capitals. He finds it at lunch. That afternoon your towel is folded into a swan.
Nobody says anything all day. He locks up at six like always and goes home.

beats.hint: A season on, it's the kit man's birthday
